summary: Completed comprehensive testing of JUSTICE platform Phase 2 features. Backend APIs working excellently (95.5% success rate), all Phase 2 features implemented and functional, but session management issues causing frequent logouts during testing.

flaky_endpoints.issue: WebSocket endpoint returns 403 Forbidden with invalid token (expected behavior)

integration_issues.issue: User sessions expire frequently during testing, causing automatic logout
integration_issues.impact: Users may experience unexpected logouts during normal usage
integration_issues.technical_details: Session tokens appear to have short expiration or are not being properly maintained in browser storage

integration_issues.issue: Auth token not accessible in browser storage for WebSocket connection
integration_issues.impact: WebSocket real-time features may not work properly
integration_issues.technical_details: Token storage mechanism may need adjustment for WebSocket context access
